detail.title: 触控显示模组及其加工方法
detail.abstract: The invention discloses a touch display module and a machining method of the touch display module. The machining method of the touch display module includes the following steps that first, a pair of alignment clamps for making a liquid crystal display be flush with a touch screen are manufactured, and glue dispensing positions are preset on the frame of the liquid crystal display; second, after semi-liquid glue is preheated to be molten, a glue dispensing machine is adopted for evenly dispensing the semi-liquid glue at the corresponding preset glue dispensing position of the frame of the liquid crystal display; third, the liquid crystal display on which semi-liquid glue is dispensed is placed in the alignment clamps, the touch screen and the liquid crystal display are assembled in the alignment clamps after being made to be aligned to each other, and the touch screen is made to be located above the liquid crystal display; fourth, the touch screen and the liquid crystal display are subjected to press fit processing through a heating press head. The semi-liquid glue is adopted for adhering fixation, and the method has the advantages that production cost is low, bonding efficiency is high, and the display effect of the touch display module is good.
